subject: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion
messages:
From: Anna Liao <anna@quasaranalytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Quasar DevOps <devops@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:14:00 -0400
Subject: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

We saw a sustained throughput regression across our production clusters starting ~09:00 PDT this morning.
- Average tokens/sec dropped ~38% for the 09:00–11:30 window
- Error rate (5xx) spiked from 0.2% to ~4.6% during the same period
- Median generation latency doubled for requests >512 tokens

I've attached a small log bundle (error_logs_20260721.zip) and screenshots from our monitoring dashboard. We opened an internal ticket (DEVOPS-8271) and have DevOps traces attached to the logs.

This is causing several customer-facing jobs to fall behind SLA thresholds; our SRE lead asked that we escalate to vendor execs for compensation and an operational plan. Please confirm receipt and advise next steps (need confirmation on a credit calculation and an ETA for a formal remediation doc).

Given the impact, Quasar will request:
1) A clear incident window and root-cause summary
2) Proposed credit/refund calculations per our contract (section 5.2)
3) A prioritized mitigation plan and timeline

We can make time for an executive sync tomorrow morning if helpful — our VP of Engineering is available 09:00–11:00 PDT.

Thanks for the quick turnaround,

Anna Liao
Director of Engineering
Quasar Analytics
anna@quasaranalytics.com
attachment: error_logs_20260721.zip (log bundle)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liao <anna@quasaranalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:32:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion

Anna — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I just pulled our initial telemetry and see the same spike; we're treating this as P1.

Immediate steps:
- Engineering (Marissa) is triaging root cause now and will post updates to the incident channel.
- We'll preserve all traces and start an accelerated RCA.
- I'll book a 30-min executive sync for tomorrow at 09:30 PDT unless you prefer a different time.

On the commercial side, I want to be transparent about our standard approach: we calculate service credits against the impacted SLA window and severity band per section 5.2 of the agreement. That said, given the customer-visible impact you describe, I'm prepared to put a provisional credit on the table pending the final incident analysis.

Next actions for us:
1) Marissa to confirm incident window and provide a short mitigation plan by EOD (internal).
2) Jonas (cc) to draft a provisional credit term we can present to you — it will be contingent on the RCA.
3) I'll loop our finance and legal teams once we have the proposed numbers so we can move to a DocuSign packet quickly.

Can you confirm the VP's availability window and whether you'd like the meeting to include Finance?

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Liao <anna@quasaranalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion

Lauren / Marissa / Anna — adding a commercial note.

We should aim to close this quickly and avoid churn. My recommendation (provisional):
- Offer a one-month service credit equivalent to the average monthly committed spend for Quasar (to be confirmed by Finance) OR a per-token refund for the impacted window — whichever is higher.
- Offer priority engineering hours for two weeks (no charge) to help Quasar re-run critical pipelines while we stabilize.

I've attached a short draft of proposed credit terms for internal review (proposed_credit_term.docx). Jonas from Finance will need exact impact numbers (tokens and window) to calculate the refund.

If we can present a provisional credit prior to tomorrow's call it will help de-escalate.

-jw

attachment: proposed_credit_term.docx

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion

Team — quick leadership guidance.

1) Prioritize an incident summary with: exact incident window, affected endpoints, customer impact (quantified), and immediate mitigations completed. Publish within 6 hours.
2) For commercial remediation, use a two-part offer: (A) an operational credit (per-token refund for impacted window) and (B) a one-time goodwill credit equal to 10% of the last monthly invoice — applied to the next billing cycle.
3) Offer two weeks of dedicated SE/Engineering time at no charge (as Jonas suggested).

Legal/Finance should prep a DocuSign amendment that allows us to apply a provisional credit pending final RCA. Marissa, please attach the incident report draft to the legal packet. Lauren, coordinate with Anna on whether Finance should join tomorrow's call.

I'll join the exec sync if the VP is on the line. This is a priority — keep me posted.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success Operations
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Anna Liao <anna@quasaranalytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Quasar production throughput drop & credit framework discussion

Thanks, all — we appreciate the quick response and the provisional approach. 09:30 PDT tomorrow for an exec sync works for us; I'll invite our VP and SRE lead.

Two quick asks before the call:
- Can you share the provisional credit numbers (range) so our procurement team has a baseline?
- ETA for the formal incident window and mitigation plan (we need that to validate the scope).

I've attached a couple more screenshots from our dashboard (perf_dashboard_screenshots.png) and flagged the key timestamps in the logs. After the call, we expect a DocuSign packet for any agreed credits.

Anna
Anna Liao
Director of Engineering, Quasar Analytics
